one_line: A 10-second product ad for reusable potty-training pants: a toddler lying on a bed with a phone is dressed in the pants, followed by close-ups of the layered pad and a green liquid being poured on it, with the brand site burned in the whole time.

hook.visual: Wide shot of a bed with about a dozen colourful animal-print training pants laid out in a row and a toddler in a pink dress lying face-down looking at a phone.
hook.on_screen_text: 'Get!' + 'BABYVK.COM' + 'SEARCH' with a cursor icon (burned in, unchanged for the full 10 s, in English)
hook.why_it_stops_the_scroll: A bright spread of cartoon-print pants plus a real toddler on a bed, then an adult starts dressing her within about 1 s; the persistent URL tag makes it read as a how-to or shop clip.

beats.observed: Bed covered with a row of coloured pants (duck, fox, frog, bunny prints); toddler in pink dress lying on her front with a phone, face turned away.
beats.spoken: No usable speech (transcript is only '(upbeat music)').

beats.observed: An adult in a white sleeve lifts the toddler's dress and starts pulling on a pair of pants.
Close-up from behind: yellow pants with a bunny or chick face and a carrot print on the toddler; two adult hands adjust the waistband. Her lower back and bottom are visible in the pants.
Hands hold a folded pair, turning it to show thick white absorbent layers; thumbs press into the pad.
An orange cup pours bright green liquid onto the white pad; it pools on the surface.
A hand opens the layers to show the yellow cartoon-face outer fabric, then presses a white napkin onto the outer face; no green is visible on the napkin in the 9 s frame.

payoff: The proof moment is at 7 to 9.85 s: liquid poured on the pad, then a napkin pressed to the outside. The video does not state any result, so any 'no leak' reading is inferred.
cta: Burned-in 'Get! BABYVK.COM SEARCH' on every frame; the caption has 'Shop link: https://babyvk.com' and about 18 hashtags.
share_or_comment_trigger: Weak: only 408 comments on 146.6M views. Parents in potty-training stage might save it as a product idea, but nothing in the clip asks for a comment or a share.
why_it_worked: 146,574,908 views is 2,463.4x the account median (59,500) while comments are only 408 and the like rate is 0.33%, which fits wide passive feed exposure more than an engaged audience (inference).
In 10 s it shows the product being put on, its layered pad and a liquid test, all in close hands-only shots with no talking and no language barrier.
The shop address is on screen from frame 0 to the last frame, so every view carries the brand.
paid_signal: likely: like rate 0.33% is only just above the 0.3% line, but 408 comments on 146.6M views and a 2,463x outlier on a shop-link ad fit paid or ad-boosted distribution. This is an inference, not proof.

solo_route.how: 1) Lay out 6 to 8 printed LumeBook sample books with different heroes in a row on a bed or table, like the pants in this video, in window light, with the phone on a tripod or stack of books. 2) Film hands-only shots of 1 to 2 s each: pick up one book, open to a hero spread, thumb through the pages, a close-up of the hero's face on the page, close the cover. 3) In CapCut, 8 to 10 s at 9:16, 5 to 6 fast cuts, upbeat music from the app's library, and a small persistent corner tag with the LumeBook name and the real site address for the full length, plus one Hebrew line at the top. About 1 hour.
solo_route.needs: Printed LumeBook sample books and nothing else. No child is needed; show only sample heroes, not a customer's child.

lumebook_version.hook_he: ככה נראה ספר שהילד שלכם הוא הגיבור שלו
lumebook_version.concept: A 10 s hands-only look at printed LumeBook books laid out like a product line, flipping to the hero spread, with a persistent brand tag on screen throughout.

evidence_notes: OBSERVED: the footage looks like filmed product video (real hands with natural skin, a real child on a real bed); I see no sign of AI generation but cannot confirm either way. The child's face is turned away or hidden in all frames. The same overlay 'Get! BABYVK.COM SEARCH' is on all 10 frames. SPOKEN: whisper.srt is only '(upbeat music)', so there is no usable speech transcript. The caption in meta.json (not visible in frames) claims the pants are soft, breathable, reusable, washable, eco-friendly and absorb accidents; the video's liquid pour does not prove those claims and the result shown after the napkin press is not conclusive. INFERRED: paid or ad-boosted distribution (see paid_signal). RISKS: a real toddler's lower back and bottom are shown in close-up in underwear-style training pants at 2 to 5 s, and the child is on a phone; we cannot see the parent's consent. A LumeBook version should not show a child's body this way, and should avoid unsupported product claims.
